descriptions: The {LOCATION} is {ADJ} with tension. The {ANTAGONIST} has caught your trail.
The {CHARACTER} from before appears at your side. 'Through here. The {MACGUFFIN} will open the door.'

commands.look: The {ANTAGONIST} is visible at the far end. The ally holds the line. North is your escape.
commands.talk to {CHARACTER}: 'I'll hold them. Go north. Don't stop.'
